resources.name: cell-countries
resources.description: Per H3 res-6 cell: country coverage, outline overlap, dispute flag, census age, population recency grade override.

fields.name: countries
fields.description: ISO3 codes of outlines covering at least 1% of the cell, largest share first, ';'-separated

fields.name: outline_share
fields.description: Share of the cell covered by any outline (capped at 1)

fields.name: outlines_overlap
fields.description: Two outlines overlap inside the cell by more than 1% of its area

fields.name: known_dispute
fields.description: Name of a contested place in the cell, from a non-authoritative list

fields.name: census_age_years
fields.description: Years since the last census of the country covering most of the cell

fields.name: census_years
fields.description: ISO3:last census year for each covering country

fields.name: pop_recency_grade_override
fields.description: Lowered recency grade (C or D) for the population layers where the census is more than 10 or 15 years old

resources.name: cell-countries-json
resources.description: The same cell records keyed by cell id, as the map reads them.
